title: Decision: Howell-Hinnant date algorithm for date arithmetic without external crate
description: message.rs lines 38-64 implement unix_secs_to_rfc3339 using the Howell-Hinnant algorithm (cited in a comment, from howardhinnant.github.io/date_algorithms.html). This is a proven, efficient way to compute civil date from days-since-epoch without pulling in a date/time crate (which would add transitive dependencies and increase binary size). Contact and chat modules implement similar logic independently. Rejected alternative: adding a chrono/time dependency would be simpler but adds coupling and bloat.
